subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

The team didn't noticed any side effects in their vaccinated mice.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the past tense "**noticed**" after "**didn't**."
 
• In English, after the auxiliary verb "**didn't**," the main verb should be in its base form, "**notice**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**didn't notice**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The team didn't **notice** any side effects in their vaccinated mice.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
 
• **Part 3: "any side effects"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "in their vaccinated mice."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
